info.title: API.SH: SeLoger
info.description: The SeLoger API from API.SH: public SeLoger data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A real estate agency on SeLoger: name, legal name, registration and SIREN numbers, legal form, head office, description, email and phone contacts, website and social links, address and coordinates, opening hours, logo, team members, customer reviews (rating, date, reviewer, text) and its current listings with price, price per m², key facts, area, rooms, bedrooms, energy class, location, photos and link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/seloger-agency

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A seloger.com/professionnels-immobilier/<id> link (the agencies in /seloger/v1/prices have one).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The agency id from that link instead of the url.

get.description:
The French places SeLoger suggests for what was typed: regions, departments, towns, districts, neighborhoods, postal codes and addresses, each with the place id the search endpoint takes as `locations`, its type, postal codes, coordinates, town code for the prices endpoint, parents and ready-made buy and rent search links.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/seloger-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A place name, postal code or address.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated types to keep: country, region, department, city, district, neighborhood, postal_code, address.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: SeLoger price per m² by town
get.description:
Property prices per m² in a French town, department or region, for sale or rent: median, low and high for apartments and for houses, price cards, the main streets with their price, the most and least expensive streets, local agencies (rating, reviews, homes sold), population and housing statistics, market facts, nearby places and the breadcrumb.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/seloger-prices

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A town or postal code (the best match is used).

parameters.name: legacy_id
parameters.description: The town code from autocomplete (`legacy_id`, e.g. 330063) instead of location.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A seloger.com/prix-de-l-immo/... page instead of location.

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.description: sale (default, price per m²) or rent (monthly rent per m²).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
SeLoger listings for a search, 30 per page, with every filter the site offers. Give either `url` (any SeLoger search URL: /immobilier/..., /recherche/... or /classified-search?...) or `locations` (SeLoger place ids, e.g. AD08FR13100). Filters apply on top of the URL. SeLoger's own search-model parameters (priceMin, numberOfRoomsMin, featuresIncluded, order, ...) are also accepted as-is.

Pass `next_page` back as `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/seloger-search

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Any SeLoger search URL. Optional when `locations` is given.

parameters.name: locations
parameters.description: SeLoger place ids, comma-separated (the last part of a /recherche/... URL, upper-cased).

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Required features, comma-separated, e.g. Elevator, Garden, Balcony_Terrace.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), newest, oldest, price_asc, price_desc, area_asc, area_desc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
